deviations.what: core:require on the view root (module preloading for the FileSizeType alias) is kept 1:1 from the original view.xml; core:require needs UI5 >= 1.74 (declared by policy - the property gate cannot see view-root require attributes).

Data-type binding paradigm: the FileSize type module is pulled in with core:require='{FileSizeType: sap/ui/model/type/FileSize}' and the Input/Text bindings carry type:'FileSizeType' plus formatOptions (min/maxIntegerDigits, min/maxFractionDigits) 1:1. The single model field 'fileSize' (initial 100, kept numeric like the sample's JSON) is serialized by abap2UI5 as /FILESIZE, so the original raw '/fileSize' paths are written as '/FILESIZE'.
